How We Work

1

Free Discovery Call

30-minute video call to understand your current workflow, the bottlenecks, and what a successful outcome looks like. No commitment, no sales pitch.

📹 Zoom · 30 min · Free
2

Solution Design & Proposal

You receive a clear written proposal with scope, timeline, and fixed price. We map the exact systems to connect and the logic to automate before writing a single line of code.

📄 Shared Doc · 2–3 business days
3

Build & Daily Updates

Development happens fully remote. You get Loom video walkthroughs as each component is completed, so you always know what's been built and what's next — no black-box delivery.

🔧 Loom · Slack · Shared board
4

Testing & Handover

Live testing session together, edge cases covered, documentation written. You get full ownership of the code and a walkthrough of how everything works.

✅ Live session · Full docs · Source code
5

Ongoing Support

Post-launch monitoring, bug fixes, and iterations as your business grows. Available via WhatsApp and email — real responses, not ticket queues.

💬 WhatsApp · Email · SLA options
